This sounds like a common “AC not cooling like it used to” situation, usually a maintenance + checkup thing, which is good news that it’s not an emergency yet.

To narrow it down and see if anything easy is causing it, can you tell me:

1) Air filter
- When was the last time you changed or cleaned the AC filter (rough guess is fine: this month / a few months / can’t remember)?
- Is it in a big return vent (wall/ceiling) or at the unit itself?

2) Outdoor unit (big box/fan outside)
- Does it look clogged with dust/leaves/cotton fluff or blocked by bushes/fence?
- When the AC is running, do you feel warm air blowing strongly out the top or sides?

3) Ice or weird sounds
- Have you ever noticed ice on the copper pipes or around the indoor unit or vents?
- Any new noises (rattling, buzzing, grinding), or just the usual fan/whirring?

4) Age
- Roughly how old is the system (or the house, if it’s likely original)?

- “Central AC tune-up and diagnostic – system runs but not cooling as well as last year.”
